::: tip WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements — met
DzImageComparison drags (drag the divider), so SC 2.5.7 applies and was audited.

- **Keyboard (SC 2.1.1):** role="slider" with tabindex 0: ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down, Home/End.
- **Single pointer, no dragging (SC 2.5.7):** handlePointerDown calls updateFromPointer(event) before any move, so a tap anywhere on the image moves the divider there.
:::
